verdict.rationale: ClickUp's docs describe a built-in AI assistant (Brain²) that can be delegated tasks, run 24/7, use memory, and pull context from workspace/apps, plus prebuilt agents (Codegen, Triage) and a 'build your own agent' feature — directly matching the story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that task delegation to the assistant actually works as advertised, and detail on limits/reliability of agent execution.
